description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultTemplateHandler class, which provides methods to register and retrieve default template handlers within the Smarty templating engine. It manages callback registration, handles default content retrieval, and interacts with Smarty source objects.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultTemplateHandler
classes.description: A class that provides methods to register a default template handler callback and to retrieve default template content in the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: registerDefaultTemplateHandler
methods.description: Registers a callback function as the default template handler for a Smarty object.

methods.name: _getDefaultTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the default template content or config content using a source object and updates its properties accordingly.
